public class FormatBlock
  extends CompoundFormat
This compound Format class is for Formats that should be appended to one another. If the text of one component Format does not fit on the rest of the line (into the given width), a new line is opened before printing that text. Example: The string list: '"foobar", "Hello world!", "Ich bin ein Berliner."' new FormatBlock(new Format[] { new FormatAppend(new Format[] { new FormatText("\"foobar\""), new FormatText(",") }), new FormatSpace(), new FormatAppend(new Format[] { new FormatText("\"Hello world!\""), new FormatText(",") }), new FormatSpace(), new FormatText("\"Ich bin ein Berliner.\"") }) width 80: "foobar", "Hello world!", "Ich bin ein Berliner." width 40: "foobar", "Hello world!", "Ich bin ein Berliner." width 20: "foobar", "Hello world!", "Ich bin ein Berliner."
